name: godot-2d-superpowers
description: Game dev workflow skills for 2D Godot solo developers.

interface.longDescription: Use this plugin to walk a 2D Godot project from a one-line idea through brainstorming, GDD, prototype, planning, layered testing, asset pipeline, level data flow, code review, debugging, finishing-the-branch, and release checklist.
defaultPrompt: Add a new feature to my 2D Godot project.
Set up a tower defense prototype.
Add card mechanics to my game.
